name: Promotora de Informaciones, S.A.
summary: Promotora de Informaciones, S.A., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploitation of media in Spain and internationally. The company provides a range educational content, such as textbooks, digital resources, support material, etc. covering preschool to Bachillerato and vocational training; and books publication services. It also offers technology, training, and assessment services to schools, teachers, and students, as well as engages in a range of activities and events, including concerts, festivals, music awards, debates, and conferences.
